title: UAAP: Louie Alas laments 'inappropriate' actions in Ateneo loss to UP

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Ateneo coach Louie Alas apologized on Tuesday after an on-court confrontation with University of the Philippines player Jacob Bayla on Saturday. With less than a second left in the Blue Eagles’ 82-74 loss to the Fighting Maroons, Alas entered the court, pointed at Bayla and cursed at him following the forward’s dunk with the game already decided. Alas again went at Bayla during the postgame handshake before engaging in an exchange with UP assistant coach Christian Luanzon despite attempts by Maroons coaches to calm him down. “I sincerely apologize for my behavior during and after our recent game against [UP].
